requirements.text: docs/standards.md Hygiene, Suite, Lens yield (and UI for UI projects) sections
Ledger schema 2 fields: ui, kind, risk, experts, replaces
Risk-to-lens rules, routine tasks take no experts, at most 4 lenses
Hygiene task required by the 3-task / 2-task-with-replaces rule and depending on every code task
UI tasks need top-level ui and risk ux unless on haiku
lenses.md with checklists, installed-skill use, dispatch and yield rules
Batch and plan review prompts check hygiene, candidates, risks and lenses
Mockup prompt carries current UI standards and the UI/UX review loop
Skill covers suite ratchet, inventory, hygiene pass, expert stages, escalation cause unknown, UI/UX and render harness
Checkpoint prints durations and journals timing
show prints risk, experts and lens dispatches
Hygiene pass over the plugin itself
Lead and every brief navigate through the codemap index when it exists
Checkpoint syncs lane changes into codemap pending.md and reports the action
Status and session brief report codemap health and propose mapping

tasks.title: Project standards for this repository
acceptance: docs/standards.md has Hygiene, Suite (baseline 1.58s, 91 tests) and Lens yield sections
tasks.reason: Project documents belong to the lead

tasks.title: Ledger schema 2 validation
acceptance: Every schema 2 rule produces its message
0.1.0 ledgers, including the finished initiative, stay valid
tasks.reason: Many interacting rules with backward compatibility; every script depends on validation

tasks.title: Lenses and prompts
acceptance: Each lens has a checklist and its installed-skill line
New prompts have their placeholders; updated prompts carry hygiene, risk and UI checks
tasks.reason: Six instruction documents whose content needs judgement to stay concise and unambiguous

tasks.title: Skill and layout for 0.2.0
acceptance: SKILL.md covers hygiene, suite ratchet, inventory, experts, escalation cause unknown, UI/UX and schema 2 in under 300 lines
layout.md defines the new standards sections, backlog tag and journal lines
tasks.reason: Risk: core behaviour of every future run; many interacting rules where ambiguity propagates system-wide

tasks.title: Checkpoint timings
acceptance: Durations printed with one decimal and kept pass/fail prefixes
Timing line in the wave journal entry
tasks.reason: Precise spec, small change across two modules and their tests

tasks.title: Report columns for risk and experts
acceptance: Risk and Experts columns, kind suffix, distinct lens dispatches per wave
tasks.reason: Formatting from a precise spec, two files

tasks.title: Codemap in status and checkpoint
acceptance: Checkpoint --mark syncs pending.md and prints the Codemap line only when the index exists
Status and brief report codemap health per the spec table, never raising
tasks.reason: Git-backed logic across status and checkpoint, runs in the session-start hook

tasks.title: Version 0.2.0 and docs
acceptance: README describes the new features and optional skills

tasks.title: Hygiene pass over the plugin
acceptance: No dead code, duplicate or obsolete tests, or noise comments; every removed test mapped to its replacement
Suite green and not slower per test than the baseline by the 20% and 2 s rule
tasks.reason: Judgement over the whole suite with the inventory as input

tasks.title: Lead verification
acceptance: All checks pass; Suite time ratchet updated
tasks.reason: Integration and verification belong to the lead
